check_service_status.description: Check whether The Color API is answering, and how quickly. This is the one action that reports a problem as a value instead of failing the step, so a workflow can decide what to do about it.

mock_response.message: The Color API is up and answering.

check_service_status.name: check_service_status

compare_colors.description: Compare two colors: how readable text in one is on the other, as the WCAG contrast ratio with a pass or fail at each level, and how far apart they look, as a colour difference where about 2 is the least a person notices and 100 is black against white. Both colors come back fully identified, so a step can also tell whether they share a name or are the same color spelled two ways. The service has no route for any of this; both colors are identified and the rest is worked out here.
compare_colors.name: compare_colors

parameters.description: The color, in any format The Color API reads: a hex code such as #0047AB or 0047AB, rgb(0,71,171), hsl(215,100%,34%), hsv(215,100%,67%) or cmyk(100,58,0,33). Three bare numbers are read as rgb, three with a percent sign as hsl and four as cmyk. Wire in a value from an earlier step, or type one.
parameters.name: color

parameters.description: The color, in any format The Color API reads: a hex code such as #0047AB or 0047AB, rgb(0,71,171), hsl(215,100%,34%), hsv(215,100%,67%) or cmyk(100,58,0,33). Three bare numbers are read as rgb, three with a percent sign as hsl and four as cmyk. Wire in a value from an earlier step, or type one.
parameters.name: other

convert_color.description: Convert one color into another format and get the converted value as a string ready to paste into a stylesheet, a design tool or a message, with its components beside it. Any of hex, rgb, hsl, hsv and cmyk converts to any other; the hex code and the name come back too, whatever the target.
convert_color.name: convert_color

parameters.description: The color, in any format The Color API reads: a hex code such as #0047AB or 0047AB, rgb(0,71,171), hsl(215,100%,34%), hsv(215,100%,67%) or cmyk(100,58,0,33). Three bare numbers are read as rgb, three with a percent sign as hsl and four as cmyk. Wire in a value from an earlier step, or type one.
parameters.name: color

parameters.description: The format to convert the color into.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Which format the color is written in. Leave empty to work it out from the value, which is right for anything but a bare hsv triple: 215,100%,67% reads as hsl unless this says HSV.
parameters.name: color_format

generate_scheme.description: Generate a color scheme from a seed color: shades of the one hue, its neighbours on the color wheel, its opposite, or three or four hues evenly spaced around it. Every color in the scheme comes back fully identified, with its name and every format, and the hex codes as a plain list for a step that only wants those. Ask for 1 to 19 colors; the service's own default is 5.
generate_scheme.name: generate_scheme

parameters.description: The color, in any format The Color API reads: a hex code such as #0047AB or 0047AB, rgb(0,71,171), hsl(215,100%,34%), hsv(215,100%,67%) or cmyk(100,58,0,33). Three bare numbers are read as rgb, three with a percent sign as hsl and four as cmyk. Wire in a value from an earlier step, or type one.
parameters.name: color

parameters.description: How the scheme is built from the seed. Monochrome keeps the hue and varies the lightness; analogic takes the neighbouring hues; complement takes the opposite hue; triad and quad space three or four hues evenly. Defaults to monochrome.
parameters.name: mode

parameters.description: How many colors to generate, from 1 to 19. Defaults to 5.
parameters.name: count

parameters.description: Which format the color is written in. Leave empty to work it out from the value, which is right for anything but a bare hsv triple: 215,100%,67% reads as hsl unless this says HSV.
parameters.name: color_format

get_random_color.description: Pick a color at random and identify it, for an accent, a label or a placeholder that should not be the same every time. Add a seed to make the pick repeatable: the same seed always gives the same color, so naming a customer, a project or a date here gives each its own color that a later run finds again.
get_random_color.name: get_random_color

parameters.description: Any text you like. The same seed always gives the same color, and a different seed almost always gives a different one. Leave empty for a fresh random color on every run.
parameters.name: seed

identify_color.description: Identify one color: its name from a dataset of some two thousand named colors, the same color in hex, rgb, hsl, hsv, cmyk and XYZ, whether it is dark, the text color that reads best on it, and a link to a swatch image. Give it the color in any of those formats. A malformed color is refused here with a message, because the service itself would quietly identify it as black.
identify_color.name: identify_color

parameters.description: The color, in any format The Color API reads: a hex code such as #0047AB or 0047AB, rgb(0,71,171), hsl(215,100%,34%), hsv(215,100%,67%) or cmyk(100,58,0,33). Three bare numbers are read as rgb, three with a percent sign as hsl and four as cmyk. Wire in a value from an earlier step, or type one.
parameters.name: color

parameters.description: Which format the color is written in. Leave empty to work it out from the value, which is right for anything but a bare hsv triple: 215,100%,67% reads as hsl unless this says HSV.
parameters.name: color_format

identify_colors.description: Identify a list of colors in one step, up to 10 at a time, in the order given: a brand palette, the colors pulled out of a design file, the swatches in a spreadsheet column. Each is looked up as Identify a color does, one request each, and the names and hex codes come back as plain lists beside the full records. Every entry is checked before the first request is made, so a bad one fails the step without spending requests on the good ones ahead of it.
identify_colors.name: identify_colors

parameters.description: The colors to identify, one per entry, each in any format The Color API reads. Wire a list in from an earlier step, or type them one per line.
parameters.name: colors

parameters.description: Which format the color is written in. Leave empty to work it out from the value, which is right for anything but a bare hsv triple: 215,100%,67% reads as hsl unless this says HSV.
parameters.name: color_format

description: Identify, convert and scheme colors with The Color API, the free keyless color service. Give it a color in any format, hex, rgb, hsl, hsv or cmyk, and get back its name, every other format and the text color that reads best on it; convert one value into another format; generate a monochrome, analogic, complementary, triad or quad scheme from a seed color; check how readable one color is on another against the WCAG contrast levels; pick a random color that a seed makes repeatable; or identify a whole list of brand colors in one step.
